usedFor: TallyPrime holds your books, and Google Chat tells finance when “New Purchase event occurs” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchase event occurs” in TallyPrime, then “Send Message” in Google Chat
bestTemplate.why: Each new purchase voucher is posted to a chat space, so finance sees spending as it is booked.

watchOut: “Account Statement Exported” also triggers in TallyPrime, so pick the purchase event if you only want voucher alerts.
